comparison.objective: Attach a hinged tipper bed and demonstrate rear unloading, unlike tuning a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Stabilize a wheeled chassis while attaching and operating a hinge, then manipulate a payload; no hex-key unlocking or feedback-driven fine setting.
comparison.success_condition: Bed attached and cube unloaded through the rear into a tray; unstabilized tipping earns only partial credit. Attachment tolerances and damage limits are not stated.
comparison.reason: Tests assembly plus stability-controlled unloading, a different capability from dynamic damping calibration.
